A largely reiterates established γ/γ′ strengthening and is weakened by the physically dubious claim that solutionizing and aging will refine grains and that finer grains necessarily improve creep at 700–1000 °C; B’s main weakness is the absence of supporting evidence and an under-specified heat treatment.
